_README: Pre-filing readiness checklist for one invention disclosure. Scored by
WHAT THE SCORE IS: a COUNT of checkable pre-filing defects closed, over the
count applicable. It is a readiness measure. It is NOT a probability of
allowance, it does not predict an examiner, and it must never be reported as
one. An allowance probability requires art-unit base-rate data from the USPTO
plus a registered practitioner's judgement. Neither is in this file.
WHY A CHECKLIST HELPS AT ALL: every item below is a defect an examiner can
raise that could have been closed before filing. Closing them cannot make an
unpatentable idea patentable. It removes self-inflicted rejections, which are
the only kind an applicant controls.
severity: BLOCKING  = do not file until closed
MATERIAL  = close or record a counsel-approved reason
status:   PASS | FAIL | NA | UNKNOWN   (UNKNOWN counts as not closed)
PROFESSIONAL VERIFICATION REQUIRED throughout. A registered patent
practitioner decides everything here. This file organises evidence for that
person; it does not substitute for them.

art_unit_base_rate._note: Fill from USPTO data or counsel. NEVER estimated. The script refuses to compute an allowance probability with or without it.

ctqs.name: 35 USC 101 - eligibility
ctqs._note: Highest-risk CTQ for a mobile talent application with AI features. Search reported that in USPTO TC working group 2120 (AI and simulation) 77 percent of office actions now include a 101 rejection - UNVERIFIED, snippet only, verify before relying on it.

items.check: Each independent claim recites a specific technical improvement to computer functionality or to a technical field, not an abstract result
Specification expressly describes the technical problem and how the claimed mechanism solves it, in the specification and not only in the claims
Claims recite HOW the result is achieved (steps, data structures, ordering) rather than WHAT result is achieved
No claim reads on a human performing the method mentally or with pen and paper
No claim is a bare method of organising human activity (hiring, matching, scheduling) with generic computer implementation
Specification quantifies the technical improvement (latency, accuracy, memory, throughput) with a stated measurement method
Every claim term has explicit support in the specification as filed
Specification enables the full scope claimed, including every alternative in a Markush or functional recitation
At least one worked example or algorithm is disclosed for each functional claim element
Any means-plus-function or computer-implemented functional term has a corresponding algorithm disclosed, not just a general-purpose processor
Drawings depict every claimed element referenced by number
Every claim term has proper antecedent basis; no 'the X' without a prior 'a X'
No relative or subjective terms without a definition in the specification (about, substantially, optimal, efficient, relevant)
Claim dependencies are correct and none is circular or references a cancelled claim
Consistent terminology; the same element is not called by two names
For each independent claim, an element-by-element comparison against the closest known reference exists, in writing
At least one claim element is identified that is absent from every reference found, with the absence stated explicitly
Search coverage is recorded: databases, date range, classifications, languages
Statutory bar check complete: no public disclosure, offer for sale, or public use more than 12 months before the filing date
The most likely two-reference combination an examiner would assert is identified in advance
A written reason why a skilled artisan would NOT have combined them, or why the combination still lacks an element
Secondary-consideration evidence gathered where it exists: unexpected results, long-felt need, commercial success, copying

ctqs.name: 37 CFR 1.56 - duty of disclosure
ctqs._note: A candor failure is not a rejection. It can render a patent unenforceable. This CTQ is why the checklist is BLOCKING-weighted here.

items.check: Every reference known to every inventor and to anyone substantively involved is listed for the IDS
Prior public disclosures, demos, pitch decks, papers, and sales activity are inventoried with dates
Any related application, foreign counterpart, or co-pending case is identified
Search results from every agent-assisted search are preserved and handed to counsel, including negative results

ctqs.name: Claim scope calibration
ctqs._note: Marco, Sarnoff and deGrazia use independent claim LENGTH and COUNT as scope measures, and report that prosecution narrows scope - UNVERIFIED, snippet only. Used here only to justify recording the measures, never to set a target number.

items.check: Independent claim word count and independent claim count are recorded before filing
A claim ladder exists: at least one broad, one intermediate, one narrow independent claim or a fallback dependent chain
At least one claim is narrow enough that counsel believes it is allowable over the closest art found
Dependent claims add distinct limitations that could each carry an amendment, not restatements

ctqs.name: Prosecution strategy set before filing
ctqs._note: Search reported an empirical study of ~1.1M applications finding examiner interviews reduce office actions from ~3.6 to ~2.0 before allowance, and another reporting up to 9 percentage points higher allowance - UNVERIFIED, snippets only. Recorded as a planned action, not as a predicted gain.

items.check: An examiner interview is planned as the default response to the first office action, not as a last resort
Art unit and examiner statistics have been obtained from a real data source before responding
A continuation strategy is decided before the first allowance, not after
Track One or accelerated examination decision made deliberately with its cost stated
Every person who contributed to conception of a claimed element is named; nobody is named who did not
Assignment and employment obligations are clear for every named inventor
No AI system is named as an inventor, and AI-assisted contributions are documented for counsel to assess
No contractor, university or government funding obligation attaches without being disclosed to counsel
Dated invention disclosure exists, written before any public disclosure
Conception and reduction-to-practice dates are documented with corroborating artifacts
The disclosure is stored in a PRIVATE repository or encrypted store, never in a public repository
